name: Equity Selloff
description: Illustrative single-factor stress: a sharp, broad-based equity market decline. Not a recreation of any specific historical crash.

name: Rapid Rate Increase
description: Illustrative single-factor stress: a fast, parallel rise in government bond yields across all tenors and currencies. Not a recreation of any specific historical rate-hiking cycle.

name: Credit Spread Widening
description: Illustrative single-factor stress: broad corporate credit spread widening across all issuers, risk-free rates unchanged. Not a recreation of any specific historical credit event.

name: Combined Severe Market Stress
description: Illustrative combined stress: equity selloff, rate rise, credit spread widening, and a volatility spike occurring together, deliberately more severe than any single-factor move to represent compounding stress. Not a recreation of any specific historical crisis (e.g. 2008 or 2020). FX is not shocked - out of this project's sensitivities scope.
